## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] Data provenance updated (`data/README.md`, `data/source-manifest.json`) if inputs changed
- [ ] Assumptions changed only in `docs/assumptions.md`, with a source or the word "assumed"
- [ ] Regulatory numbers cite an MRA or Bangladesh Bank document
- [ ] Real and synthetic data kept apart; every synthetic output is labeled SYNTHETIC
- [ ] No real client, loan, savings or field-collected data
